criteria.text: A failed repair-judge call records what actually failed: the exception class and a classification separating a transport failure from an output the schema rejected from a fault of ours.
A failing call is retried once before the customer loses the reply, both attempts are counted against the paid-call cap, and the worst-case wait on the customer's turn does not grow.
The repair path stops competing for its own token budget: reasoning is disabled per path rather than per model id, and the budget fits a whole rewritten reply plus its rationale.
